instagram:
Will your external auditor catch fraud?

In our view, myth. An audit tests samples and gives reasonable assurance, not a guarantee; preventing fraud starts with your own controls.

Two people approve every payment
Supplier bank changes confirmed on a number you already hold
Bank reconciliations reviewed monthly by someone other than the preparer

Our audit & risk advisory reviews controls before year-end. Valorin is not an audit firm.
